record.question: Which statement is false regarding deposit of money received on behalf of the government?
options: Moneys received by or tendered to government officers must be paid in full into a treasury without undue delay
Revenue for the government may be appropriated to meet the departmental expenses, but be adjusted from the next budget of the new financial year
Revenue received by courts may be utilised to refund deposits
Moneys deposited into the Treasury must be included in the accounts of the government
